name: Nanase Riku
source:
Riku Nanase is the center of IDOLiSH7, an honest and hard worker who tries his best in whatever he does. He carries a form of lovability that inspires both the people around him and fans alike to cheer him on. 

[Taken from [url=https://idolish7.miraheze.org/wiki/Riku_Nanase]IDOLiSH7 Wiki[/url]]
